query_text: Set up a new router for wifi access

content.text:
I can help guide you through setting up a new router for WiFi access! Here's a step-by-step guide:

---

## 🛜 Setting Up a New Router for WiFi Access

### **Step 1: Gather What You Need**
- Your new router
- A modem (provided by your ISP) or a modem/router combo
- An Ethernet cable (usually included with the router)
- Your computer, tablet, or smartphone
- Your ISP account credentials (if required)

---

### **Step 2: Connect the Hardware**
1. **Power off your modem** (unplug it from the wall).
2. **Connect the modem to the router** using an Ethernet cable — plug one end into the modem's LAN/output port and the other into the router's **WAN/Internet port** (usually a different color).
3. **Power on the modem first**, wait ~60 seconds for it to initialize.
4. **Power on the router** and wait for it to fully boot up (usually 1–2 minutes).

---

### **Step 3: Access the Router's Admin Panel**
- Connect your device to the router via **Ethernet cable** or the **default WiFi network** (found on the label on the bottom/back of the router).
- Open a **web browser** and type the router's default IP address (commonly `192.168.0.1` or `192.168.1.1`) into the address bar.
- Log in using the **default admin username and password** (also found on the router label — often `admin/admin` or `admin/password`).

> 💡 Many modern routers also have a **mobile app** (e.g., Netgear Nighthawk, ASUS Router, TP-Link Tether) that walks you through setup automatically.

---

### **Step 4: Run the Setup Wizard**
Most routers have a **Setup Wizard** that launches automatically on first login. Follow the prompts to:
- Detect your internet connection type (DHCP, PPPoE, Static IP — your ISP can tell you which one)
- Enter any required **ISP credentials** (usually for PPPoE connections)

---

### **Step 5: Configure Your WiFi Network**
In the router's admin panel, navigate to **Wireless Settings** and configure:

| Setting | Recommendation |
|---|---|
| **Network Name (SSID)** | Choose a unique name (avoid using personal info) |
| **WiFi Password** | Use a strong password (12+ characters, mix of letters, numbers, symbols) |
| **Security Protocol** | Choose **WPA3** or **WPA2** (avoid WEP — it's outdated and insecure) |
| **Frequency Band** | Enable both **2.4 GHz** (longer range) and **5 GHz** (faster speeds) if available |

---

### **Step 6: Change the Admin Password**
- Go to **Administration/Management Settings** in the router panel.
- Change the **default admin password** to something strong and unique.
- This prevents unauthorized access to your router settings.

---

### **Step 7: Save Settings & Reboot**
- Click **Save/Apply** to save all your settings.
- The router will likely **reboot** — wait 1–2 minutes.

---

### **Step 8: Connect Your Devices**
- On your devices, search for your new **WiFi network name (SSID)**.
- Enter your new **WiFi password**.
- Test your internet connection by opening a website or running a speed test at [fast.com](https://fast.com) or [speedtest.net](https://speedtest.net).

---

### **✅ Optional but Recommended Steps**
- **Update the router's firmware** (check under Administration > Firmware Update) for the latest security patches.
- **Set up a Guest Network** for visitors so they can't access your main network.
- **Enable firewall settings** if not already on by default.
- **Note down your credentials** somewhere safe (admin password, WiFi password).

---

Do you have a specific router brand or model? I can provide more tailored instructions if needed! 😊
